title: Filling Bookcase Shelves
summary: Given an array of books with their thickness and height, and a shelf width, arrange the books in order to minimize the total height of the bookshelf.
statement: Given an array of books with their thickness and height, and a shelf width, arrange the books in order to minimize the total height of the bookshelf. Place books on shelves such that the total thickness does not exceed the shelf width, and the height of each shelf is the maximum height of the books on that shelf. Continue until all books are placed, ensuring the order of books is maintained.
constraints: Books remain in order and each shelf width cannot exceed shelfWidth.
hints: Let dp[end] be minimum height for the first end books.
Try every suffix that fits as the final shelf while maintaining its maximum height.
Every valid arrangement has one such final shelf, making the recurrence exhaustive.
